starterCta.emptyBodyLine1: Creates five Markdown starter files: project, domain, capability, element, and README. It also creates .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml.
starterCta.emptyBodyLine2: Edit each file's info block to match your project; Atlas updates the tree, map, and editor from those files.
starterCta.definitionBody: A record in Markdown of what this folder builds, what it depends on, and what a change affects. Projects, domains, capabilities, elements, and their relations make up the ontology.
starterCta.proofLocalBody: Markdown files are the database. No account or server; Atlas reads and writes this folder.
starterCta.proofGraphBody: Atlas checks that concepts and relations form a consistent graph.
starterCta.proofAgentBody: Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex read the same folder before editing.
starterCta.verifyAriaLabel: Starter includes AI agent verification steps
starterCta.verifyStepFiles: Creates agent configs for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
starterCta.verifyStepMcp: README requires validate_vault, workspace_brief, and agent_brief before edits.
starterCta.verifyStepCli: CLI fallbacks provide the same self-check and mcp-verify proof.
starterCta.secondaryTitle: Adds 5 ontology starter files plus agent verification guidance (existing files are left untouched)
starterCta.secondaryCopyTitle: Copy the read-first agent-connection (MCP) verification prompt without adding starter files
starterCta.secondaryCliTitle: Copy commands that prove the same connection in a terminal without an agent
starterCta.secondaryJsonGateTitle: Copy the JSON self-check command that Claude Code / Codex setup automation can read directly
